crossRefs.note: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
translations.bsb: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
translations.kjv: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
translations.asv: And Absalom, and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
